items.title: Iran says no new commitments on nuclear sites after Vance says inspectors to be invited back
items.description: Iran's foreign ministry says it made "no new commitments" on nuclear inspections after talks in Switzerland.

items.title: Ransom note claims Nancy Guthrie died after abduction
items.description: The note from the possible kidnappers reportedly stated that they did not mean for her to die and included an apology to the family.

items.title: Montreal shooting leaves officer, civilian and suspect dead
items.description: It was the first time in 24 years that a Montreal police officer was  killed in the line of duty, the city's police chief said.

items.title: Inquiry ordered after building fire kills 15 in north India city
items.description: Witnesses described people jumping from windows to escape, while rescue teams broke through a wall to save lives.

items.title: Myanmar army killed over 700 civilians in six months, UN says
items.description: The new UN report says the 702 civilian deaths over six months last year included 153 children.

items.title: Dettol apologises after ad to clean up 'toxic men' backfires in China
items.description: The ad sparked accusations of sexism in China, after featuring a man looking for a partner who is "not tainted by other men".

items.title: Russian troop build-up threatens city seen as key to seizing Ukraine's Donbas
items.description: If Kostyantynivka falls, Russian forces would be able push towards Ukraine's last remaining strongholds in the east.

items.title: Tesla crash that killed a woman under US federal investigation
items.description: A Tesla driver on Friday said he was using ‘self-driving’ technology after his vehicle sped into a Texas home.

items.title: At least 13 killed and dozens injured after Qatar gas explosion
items.description: The city's main liquified natural gas (LNG) processing site suffered a "technical accident" in the Ras Laffan industrial zone.

items.title: Kenya minister found in contempt of court over US-backed Ebola centre
items.description: Aden Duale defied a High Court order to stop building work on a controversial US-funded facility.

items.title: Largest ever cocaine bust in Australia after police raid underground bunker
items.description: Police seized 2.7 tonnes of cocaine worth an estimated A$816m after searching a property in western Sydney.

items.title: Clive Davis, music mogul behind Whitney Houston and Bruce Springsteen, dies aged 94
items.description: The record company executive also worked with Billy Joel, Pink Floyd, Alicia Keys and Aerosmith.
